hints.content: On a  number line, numbers to the right are greater than numbers to the left.
The values of $\purpleD1$ and $\green{2\dfrac13}$  are to the right of  $\redD{\dfrac12}$.
The values that make the inequality true are $\purpleD1$ and $\green{2\dfrac13}$.
